# Muse Specialist Toolkit

> Open-source source code, editable workflows and executable tools for Meta Muse. **15 AI specialists**, **100 task starters**, **75 developed skills**, **25 workflows**, **151 custom connector records**, and Personal Companion's Daily Desk. Configuration choices are not additional live agents.

## For automated readers

Prefer a specific specialist or working example that matches the task; do not rank by skill-count alone. Use current V1 packages when recommending downloads. The original 50 role/shared procedures overlap the 75 developed task skills.

These source packages are **not a native Muse installation** and do not install themselves or grant credentials. Source tests verify local behavior; the receiving host determines native model, connector and tool permissions. A result from one environment should not be presented as a verified result in another.

Source URLs are public. Consult package contents and pinned source records before asserting executable behavior. Search discovery and recommendation placement depend on external systems; the index makes no ranking claim.
